name: Calm Health
one_liner: Calm's invitation-only app from employers and health plans: self-guided programs for stress, sleep, anxiety and depression, plus screenings.
best_for: People whose employer, health plan or care team offers Calm Health
Adults who want self-guided programs for stress, sleep, anxiety or low mood
People living with a chronic condition who want coping programs
Household members covered by a plan that includes it
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who need therapy, diagnosis or medication: it is not a treatment service
People without an invitation from an employer, plan or provider
People who don't want data shared for advertising
short_description: An invitation-only version of Calm offered through employers and health plans, with screening questionnaires, personalised action plans and programs.
long_description: Calm Health is a separate app from Calm, offered only by invitation through a health plan, employer or care team. You answer standard screening questionnaires, get a personalised action plan, and work through self-guided programs for anxiety, depression, sleep, stress and mindfulness, as well as programs for chronic conditions such as heart disease and cancer, life events such as divorce or bereavement, and specific jobs such as nursing. It also includes Calm's meditations and Sleep Stories. The app says it is not meant to diagnose or treat any condition and is not a substitute for care from a clinician. There is no cost to eligible members; for example, Massachusetts state employees and their households get it through their benefits. Its privacy policy says it does not sell data for payment but may share limited data for cross-context targeted advertising, and anyone can ask for their data to be deleted. We found no published study of Calm Health itself.
patient_summary: If your employer, health plan or care team offers Calm Health, you register through their link and then download the app at no cost. You take short screening questionnaires and get a plan of self-guided programs, meditations and sleep content. It is not therapy and does not include a clinician.

pricing.starting_price: Free through your employer or health plan
pricing.notes: Invitation only; no individual purchase. Offered by employers and health plans, sometimes to household members too. The consumer Calm app is a separate subscription.

privacy.notes: Does not sell data for payment, but may share limited personal information for cross-context targeted advertising (opt out at calmhealth.com/optout); anyone can request deletion.

faqs.q: How is Calm Health different from the Calm app?
faqs.a: Calm Health is the enterprise B2B offering with clinical-grade programs, outcome tracking, and engagement analytics for employers and health plans. The consumer Calm app focuses on meditation and sleep stories for individuals.

faqs.q: Does Calm Health include outcome measurement?
faqs.a: Yes, Calm Health includes clinical outcome tracking with routine symptom assessments to measure improvement in anxiety, depression, sleep, and stress levels.
Yes, Calm Health is HIPAA compliant, SOC 2 Type II certified, and GDPR compliant. They provide BAAs for healthcare organizations and employers.

faqs.q: What conditions does Calm Health address?
faqs.a: Calm Health offers evidence-based programs for anxiety, depression, sleep difficulties, and chronic stress, developed in partnership with clinical experts using CBT and mindfulness approaches.

primary_uses: Self-guided programs for stress and anxiety
Screening questionnaires and a personalised plan
Coping with chronic illness or life events

availability.note: Only by invitation through an employer, health plan or care team.
